4_tiles_and_icons.method: Procedural PIL generation in the DEEPFALL style (build_wave_tiles.py, seed 20261101). Tile variants: strong motif overlays on v0 (mortar re-draw, moss reseed, cracks, bubble re-draw, re-speckle, plank re-draw). Icons: 16x16 PIL pixel art.
4_tiles_and_icons.note: Geometric transforms of v0 (flip/rotate) were tried first and REJECTED: the motifs are near-symmetric, giving mean-abs diffs of ~1.1-1.5 vs the 7-25 of the existing v0-v3. The strong-overlay approach gives genuinely different tiles.
4_tiles_and_icons.source: RLTiles (public domain per the repo README License section, asset-wave-research/repos/rltiles/; no standalone LICENSE file) as STYLE/COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY. No RLTiles pixels lifted - RLTiles tiles are top-down and DEEPFALL is side-view, so a lift would read wrong.
